checks.result: Calls with command over 16 KiB are rejected with 413 before policy/preview/audit. Pending approval preview payload is bounded to <= 128 KiB, and disk_low recheck blocks creation when disk space is below min_free_bytes.

checks.result: Adversarial 16 KiB inputs parse in under 100 ms (< 40 ms typical). All hidden command structures (sh -c, backticks, $(), quotes, comments) remain detected by simple_programs and Policy.decide.

checks.invariant: preview_command caps container expand/walk calls at PREVIEW_CALLS_MAX (40) with operand deduplication, notes at NOTES_MAX (50), and sandbox._expand/_walk enforce 10s timeouts via _PREVIEW_TIMEOUT and _preview_ok.
checks.result: 1000 rm operands trigger exactly 40 container calls with deduplication, notes are capped at 51 with warning, and container calls have 10s timeout.

checks.invariant: Unit test suite verifies regression bounds for PR #24 argument caps, policy relex skips, preview call and notes limits, and pending row bounding.
checks.result: All test_m5_unit.py tests pass cleanly in 2.99s.

checks.invariant: Approval preview accurately reports the files that will be deleted by the executing shell command (/bin/bash), and warns if shell expansion or substitution semantics differ.
checks.result: Discrepancy confirmed: _expand runs in /bin/sh (dash) where brace expansion ({a,b}) and positional parameter tilde expansion (~/file) are not performed, causing preview_command to falsely report '삭제 시도 (현재 존재하지 않음)' with no warning notes, while executing shell (/bin/bash) deletes the existing files.

checks.result: templates/_approvals.html renders preview.affected table and preview.notes. Because preview_command appends no note when matches is empty, the operator sees '현재 존재하지 않음' for brace/tilde targets without any warning that shell expansion failed.

candidates.title: Approval impact preview misreports rm targets under brace and tilde expansion as nonexistent
candidates.description: The human approval preview card computes file impact by tokenizing the command with shlex and passing operands to container callbacks (_expand and _walk). In sandbox.py:_expand, the pattern is evaluated in container /bin/sh (dash), where brace expansion (e.g. {a,b}.txt, {1..100}) and positional parameter tilde expansion (~/file) are not performed. When _expand tests existence via [ -e "$p" ], no file literally named "{a,b}.txt" or "/workspace/~/file" exists, returning an empty match list. preview_command (preview.py:110-111) maps this to {'path': op, 'effect': '삭제 시도 (현재 존재하지 않음)'} and appends no warning note. When the human approves the action believing the target does not exist, sandbox.py:425 executes the command via /bin/bash, which performs full brace and tilde expansion and deletes the real files.
candidates.root_cause: The preview command parsing and container path expansion logic diverges from the execution shell. preview_command in preview.py tokenizes commands with POSIX shlex and delegates expansion to _expand, which invokes /bin/sh (dash) with positional argument $1. POSIX dash does not support brace expansion and does not expand tildes within variable expansions, returning empty matches for {a,b} and ~ operands. Furthermore, preview.py:88 warns only on $, `, <, and eval, failing to flag brace or tilde characters. The system erroneously asserts that targets do not exist rather than warning that shell expansion could not be calculated.
candidates.intended_behavior: Approval impact preview should either execute expansion using the same shell (bash) and environment as execution, or detect shell-specific expansion constructs such as { and ~ and add an explicit warning note (notes) that the exact affected files could not be computed automatically, prompting the operator to inspect the raw command before approval.

trace.description: Agent submits an exec tool request with rm command using brace or tilde expansion.
Policy routes destructive command to require_approval and invokes _preview.
Delegates to preview_command with container _expand and _walk callbacks.
Loops over rm operands and calls expand(op) for brace/tilde pattern.
Runs /bin/sh (dash) script where $1 does not expand braces or tildes, returning empty list.
Appends '삭제 시도 (현재 존재하지 않음)' to affected list with no warning note.
Operator is presented with an approval card stating target does not exist, and upon approval bash deletes real files.

evidence.description: preview_command maps empty expand(op) result to '삭제 시도 (현재 존재하지 않음)' without warning note.
_expand executes via /bin/sh (dash) script where positional $1 lacks brace and tilde expansion.
exec runs under /bin/bash where brace and tilde expansions take place upon execution.

conditions.description: Agent must have token to call tools on its sandbox.
Human operator must approve the pending exec request based on the inaccurate impact card.

execution.attacker_perspective: Agent issues exec tool call: POST /sandboxes/{sid}/tools/exec with command 'rm {a,b}.txt' where 'a.txt' and 'b.txt' exist in /workspace.
instructions: Run preview_command('rm {a,b}.txt', 200, expand, walk) using container _expand.
Observe that preview card lists 'affected': [{'path': '{a,b}.txt', 'effect': '삭제 시도 (현재 존재하지 않음)'}] and empty 'notes'.
Execute 'bash -c "umask 002\nrm {a,b}.txt"' as in sandbox.py:425 and observe that 'a.txt' and 'b.txt' are deleted.
execution.observed_result: Preview reported affected: [{'path': '{a,b}.txt', 'effect': '삭제 시도 (현재 존재하지 않음)'}], notes: []. Bash execution deleted both a.txt and b.txt, leaving remaining files: [].

remediation.strategy: In preview.py:88, include '{' and '~' in the check for shell substitution/expansion constructs, or update _expand to use bash with nullglob or flag unexpanded braces so that notes warns the operator that file impact could not be automatically calculated.

code_changes.fixed_code:
if any(s in command for s in ("$", "`", "<(", "eval ", "{", "~")):
        notes.append("변수·명령 치환이나 중괄호·틸드 확장이 있어 실제로 무엇이 실행될지 자동 계산이 정확하지 않을 수 있음. 명령 원문을 확인할 것.")

likelihood.reason: Requires prompt-injected agent to use brace or tilde expansion in rm command and human operator to rely on nonexistent status on card.

impact.reason: Action-binding card misreports existence of target files to the human operator before destructive deletion.

confidence.reason: Demonstrated through exact sandboxed reproduction matching container shell and preview implementation.

hardening: In agentbox/service.py:323-324, TOOL_ARG_MAX length check exempts k != 'content' unconditionally for all tools rather than restricting the exemption to (tool == 'write_file' and k == 'content'). An agent calling exec can supply a large content payload (up to body cap 8 MiB) without triggering 413, although the payload is not used by exec or policy.decide and finished approval rows are compacted via _logged_args.

In agentbox/preview.py:88, preview_command checks for ('$', '`', '<(', 'eval ') to warn the operator of variable or command substitution, but does not check for '{' (brace expansion) or '~' (tilde expansion).
